facts.value: According to the Collegedunia Rankings 2026, the top 5 Medical Colleges in Pune for MBBS.

Admission to AFMC Pune is based on the NEET UG score, followed by AFMC's own screening process, which includes the Test of English Language, Reasoning and Logic (ToELR), an interview, and a medical fitness examination.
Selected candidates serve in the Armed Forces Medical Services after graduation as per the service liability bond.
The total course fee at AFMC Pune is INR 98,960, making it the cheapest MBBS college in Pune.
Symbiosis Medical College for Women (SMCW), Pune, is the only MBBS college in Pune exclusively for women.
The total MBBS course fee at SMCW Pune is INR 72.55 Lakh.

BJMC Pune, AFMC Pune, SKNMCGH Pune, and MIMER Pune are affiliated with the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS), Nashik. SMCW Pune and SIU Pune come under Symbiosis International (Deemed University), BVMC Pune under Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed University), and DYPMC Pune under Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth (DPU), Pune.

The internship stipend at Medical Colleges in Pune is INR 18,000 per month as per Maharashtra Government norms, applicable to government colleges from February 2024, directed by the DMER to private colleges as well. AFMC Pune interns receive INR 60,000 – 75,000 per month as per the 7th CPC norms.
NEET and Maharashtra NEET Counselling are the main entrance exams considered by most of the colleges in Pune.

Common documents required for MBBS admission include: NEET UG Scorecard & Admit Card, Class 10 (DOB) certificate, Class 12 marksheet & passing certificate (PCB + English), Transfer Certificate / Character Certificate (if required), Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) and domicile certificate (for state quota), Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID), Passport-size photographs (as per specification), Medical fitness certificate, migration certificate (if needed), Payment receipts/bank drafts for fees or deposits.

No, direct admission to the MBBS course is not allowed in India. Even for the management quota, students must at least qualify for the NEET exam; only then are candidates eligible to participate in the management quota.
